admission.justification: Both shapes were live (SourceExplorer/UnexplainedLane/panel vs page); every later file/worklist/disclosure change must keep the single page, the own view and the count.

alternatives.option: One existing comparison change-set viewer with filters and return, a separate leaf-worklist view, and no leaf-wide knowledge diff. Required changed review content stays open; the main page admits at most 20 identifiers/provenance disclosures, up to two unchanged/not-comparable location groups per shown subject, and one fold per unchanged stretch of a shown card.
alternatives.reason: D48's single diff owner and own worklist place remain. Approved MIK-R86 v2 rules 12-13 amend the disclosure classes and per-subject budgets, while MIK-R89 v2 rules 4-6 keep changed lines open, bound unchanged groups and put raw records in one bottom provenance disclosure.

alternatives.option: Reviewer-owned file lists with focused diffs plus the Knowledge-changes panel with raw patches and per-item facts dumps.
alternatives.reason: D48 rules it out: three file lists for the same 179 files and 1,037 panel disclosures.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A comparison the change-set routes cannot name must still be judged file by file inside the review.

consequences: Keep one existing comparison change-set viewer with its filters and way back, and a separate reachable leaf-worklist view; retain the rejection of reviewer-owned duplicate file lists and per-item facts dumps.

The main-page limit is at most 20 identifiers/provenance disclosures, plus at most two unchanged/not-comparable groups per shown subject, plus one fold per unchanged stretch in a shown card. Changed content is not folded and opened groups show location lines rather than cards.

The raw comparison/subject records live in one closed Technical details provenance disclosure at the bottom of the reading column; the old all-disclosures-total wording is superseded by these explicit classes.
